# NEW 2026-11-22 v18.5 Module 18.5-D: 10 Peace Treaty Apply Effects + Exported Yearly Hook oe_war2_kernel_yearly (oe_war2_effects.txt) (oe_war2_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v185_warfare_treaties.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ==============================================================================
# A. 10 Peace Treaty Apply Effects (scope:winner, scope:loser)
# ==============================================================================

# 1. Force Open Treaty Ports
oe_war2_apply_pt_open_treaty_ports = {
	scope:winner = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_pt_ports_winner years = 20 mode = replace }
	}
	scope:loser = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_pt_ports_loser years = 20 mode = replace }
		add_opinion = { target = scope:winner modifier = oe_war2_op_treaty_resentment }
	}
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = oe_war2_pt_open_treaty_ports_tt
		if = {
			limit = {
				can_add_relation = {
					first = scope:loser
					second = scope:winner
					type = relation_type:oe_war2_rel_treaty_port_concession
				}
			}
			create_relation = {
				type = relation_type:oe_war2_rel_treaty_port_concession
				first = scope:loser
				second = scope:winner
			}
		}
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		scope:winner = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_war2.7 days = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# 2. Installment War Indemnities
oe_war2_apply_pt_installment_reparations = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = oe_war2_pt_installment_reparations_tt
		scope:loser = {
			add_gold = {
				value = country_economical_base
				multiply = -1.5
				max = -30
				min = -350
			}
		}
		scope:winner = {
			add_gold = {
				value = scope:loser.country_economical_base
				multiply = 1.5
				min = 30
				max = 350
			}
		}
	}
	scope:winner = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_pt_reparations_winner years = 15 mode = replace }
	}
	scope:loser = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_pt_reparations_loser years = 15 mode = replace }
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		scope:winner = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_war2.8 days = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# 3. Dismantle Frontier Fortresses
oe_war2_apply_pt_raze_border_forts = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = oe_war2_pt_raze_border_forts_tt
		scope:loser = {
			ordered_fort_in_country = {
				limit = { has_fort = yes }
				order_by = population
				max = 2
				check_range_bounds = no
				every_buildings_in_location = {
					limit = { building_category = defense_category }
					location = { destroy_building = prev }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	scope:winner = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_pt_forts_winner years = 15 mode = replace }
	}
	scope:loser = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_pt_forts_loser years = 15 mode = replace }
		add_opinion = { target = scope:winner modifier = oe_war2_op_treaty_resentment }
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		scope:winner = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_war2.9 days = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# 4. Seize Royal Archives & Masterworks
oe_war2_apply_pt_seize_royal_manuscripts = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = oe_war2_pt_seize_royal_manuscripts_tt
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:winner = { exists = capital }
				scope:loser = { oe_war2_has_plunderable_manuscript = yes }
			}
			scope:loser = {
				ordered_work_of_art_in_country = {
					limit = { art_is_priceless = no }
					order_by = art_quality
					max = 1
					check_range_bounds = no
					move_art_and_owner = {
						location = scope:winner.capital
						country = scope:winner
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	scope:winner = {
		add_prestige = 12
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_pt_manuscripts_winner years = 15 mode = replace }
	}
	scope:loser = {
		add_prestige = -10
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_pt_manuscripts_loser years = 15 mode = replace }
		set_variable = { name = oe_war2_plundered_by value = scope:winner years = 25 }
		add_opinion = { target = scope:winner modifier = oe_war2_op_treaty_resentment }
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		scope:winner = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_war2.10 days = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
}

	}
	scope:loser = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_pt_language_loser years = 20 mode = replace }
		add_opinion = { target = scope:winner modifier = oe_war2_op_treaty_resentment }

		}

}

# 7. Dissolve Hostile Coalition Pledge
oe_war2_apply_pt_break_coalition_oath = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = oe_war2_pt_break_coalition_oath_tt
		scope:loser = {
			every_related_country = {
				type = alliance
				limit = {
					NOT = { this = scope:winner }
					OR = {
						is_great_power = yes
						is_rival_of = scope:winner
					}
				}
				remove_relation = {
					first = scope:loser
					second = this
					type = relation_type:alliance
				}
			}
		}
	}
	scope:winner = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_pt_coalition_winner years = 15 mode = replace }
	}
	scope:loser = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_pt_coalition_loser years = 15 mode = replace }
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		scope:winner = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_war2.8 days = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# 10. Establish Neutral Buffer Charter
oe_war2_apply_pt_release_tributary_buffer = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = oe_war2_pt_release_tributary_buffer_tt
		scope:winner = {
			add_truce_with = { target = scope:loser years = 10 mutual = yes }
			set_variable = { name = oe_war2_buffer_guarantor_against value = scope:loser years = 20 }
		}
	}
	scope:winner = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_pt_buffer_winner years = 20 mode = replace }
	}
	scope:loser = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_pt_buffer_loser years = 20 mode = replace }
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		scope:winner = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_war2.12 days = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# B. Exported O(1) Zero-Slot Yearly Hook (self-dedup via global_var:oe_war2_ran_y)
# Dispatches all 12 visible events oe_war2.1..oe_war2.12 for human realms.
# ==============================================================================
oe_war2_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_war2_ran_y ?= current_year }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_war2_ran_y value = current_year }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				oe_main_mod_global_event_allowed = yes
				oe_years_since_start >= 12
				num_locations > 0
			}
			# 1. Spanish Tercio Pike-and-Shot Square (Age 3+)
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_war2_ev_1_done }
					oe_war2_is_tercio_doctrine_country = yes
				}
				set_variable = oe_war2_ev_1_done
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_war2.1 days = 15 }
			}
			# 2. Ming Mandarin Duck (Yuanyang) Array (Age 2+)
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_war2_ev_2_done }
					current_age_or_later = { age = age_2_renaissance }
					oe_war2_is_ming_weisuo_country = yes
				}
				set_variable = oe_war2_ev_2_done
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_war2.2 days = 20 }
			}
			# 3. Weisuo Wagon-Camp & Military Colonies
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_war2_ev_3_done }
					oe_main_mod_old_world_event_allowed = yes
					current_age_or_later = { age = age_2_renaissance }
					oe_war2_is_ming_weisuo_country = yes
				}
				set_variable = oe_war2_ev_3_done
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_war2.3 days = 25 }
			}
			# 4. Steppe Mangudai & Timariot Cavalry Exercises
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_war2_ev_4_done }
					current_year >= 1348
					OR = {
						oe_war2_is_steppe_mangudai_country = yes
						oe_war2_is_ottoman_timariot_country = yes
					}
				}
				set_variable = oe_war2_ev_4_done
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_war2.4 days = 30 }
			}
			# 5. Byzantine Stratiotai Phalanx & Colony Rosters
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_war2_ev_5_done }
					oe_main_mod_old_world_event_allowed = yes
					current_year >= 1352
					num_locations >= 45
					oe_war2_is_byz_phalanx_country = yes
				}
				set_variable = oe_war2_ev_5_done
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_war2.5 days = 35 }
			}
			# 6. Line-Infantry Volley Rank & Mass Conscription (Age 5+)
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_war2_ev_6_done }
					oe_war2_is_line_volley_era = yes
				}
				set_variable = oe_war2_ev_6_done
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_war2.6 days = 40 }
			}
			# 7. Grand Treaty-Port & Silk Corridor Charter (Age 3+ maritime/market realm)
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_war2_ev_7_done }
					current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
					OR = {
						oe_war2_is_maritime_treaty_power = yes
						has_markets = yes
					}
				}
				set_variable = oe_war2_ev_7_done
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_war2.7 days = 45 }
			}
			# 8. Congress of Indemnities & Broken Coalitions (Age 4+ great power/rank 3+)
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_war2_ev_8_done }
					current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation }
					OR = {
						is_great_power = yes
						country_rank_level >= 3
					}
				}
				set_variable = oe_war2_ev_8_done
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_war2.8 days = 50 }
			}
			# 9. Frontier Fortresses Dismantled (any fortified realm, Age 3+)
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_war2_ev_9_done }
					current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
					any_fort_in_country = { has_fort = yes }
				}
				set_variable = oe_war2_ev_9_done
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_war2.9 days = 55 }
			}
			# 10. Royal Archives, Masterworks & Sovereign Tongue (Age 3+, works of art)
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_war2_ev_10_done }
					current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
					num_works_of_art >= 1
				}
				set_variable = oe_war2_ev_10_done
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_war2.10 days = 60 }
			}
			# 11. Maritime Tonnage Convention & Raider Patrols (Age 4+, maritime power)
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_war2_ev_11_done }
					current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation }
					oe_war2_is_maritime_treaty_power = yes
				}
				set_variable = oe_war2_ev_11_done
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_war2.11 days = 65 }
			}
			# 12. Sacred Pilgrim Passage & Neutral Buffer Guarantee (Age 4+, rank 2+)
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_war2_ev_12_done }
					current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation }
					country_rank_level >= 2
				}
				set_variable = oe_war2_ev_12_done
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_war2.12 days = 70 }
			}
		}
	}
}
